newsitem.title: UK: Extra 120,000 t gas oil goes to U.S. in arb - trad.
newsitem.headline: Extra 120,000 t gas oil goes to U.S. in arb - trad.

text.p: About 120,000 tonnes of Russian gas oil is due to arrive in the United States in the next week under arbitrage from NWE, in addition to a previously reported 60,000 tonne vessel also headed to the U.S., traders said on Friday.
One 60,000 tonne vessel of heating oil is due into Boston and another of the same size into New York around December 25, traded at between NYMEX heating oil quotes -25 and -80 points, traders said.

They are in addition to a 62,200 tonne, 0.2 percent sulphur Russian heating oil sold into New York late on Thursday at NYMEX heating oil quotes -60 points and due to arrive before the end of December.

That level is equivalent to around $227 a tonne or $11 over front month gas oil futures in London. Russian gas oil for prompt delivery is assessed at around $1.75/2.75 over January IPE futures, which traded at $216.50 at 1508 GMT.

The arbitrage has been opened by a combination of slack NWE heating oil demand and a firmer market in the United States amid tight supply and forecasts of colder-than-normal temperatures in the U.S. Northeast, the world's largest heating oil market.
While arbitrage efforts are concentrated mostly on 60,000 tonne cargoes, efforts are also being made to fix smaller vessels.
Two Russians of around 75,00 tonnes each loading currently in Ventspils are seen destined mostly likely for Asia, traders said.
